scheme_name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be pursuing the first year of the degree course or the second year through lateral entry.
A maximum of two girl children per family are eligible.
benefits_summary: ₹50,000 per annum for up to 4 years for first‑year students or up to 3 years for second‑year students, payable as a lump sum towards college fees and related expenses.
